title: ExpressionEntry
description: A reviewed Kasem expression — a greeting, blessing, idiom or saying — published whole, with its meaning, the situation it is used in and where it came from. Written only by the trusted review workflow into `expressionEntries`. Deliberately separate from dictionary entries: an expression is never split into headwords, numbered as a homograph or counted as a word.

phrase.description: The expression in Kasem, whole and exactly as approved.

alternatives.description: Other complete ways of saying the same thing in Kasem. Each is a whole expression, never a word list.

meaning.description: What the expression means, in English — the sense a speaker intends, not a word-for-word gloss.

literalTranslation.description: Optional word-for-word reading, kept apart from the meaning because an idiom's words and its sense differ.

context.description: When the expression is used: who says it, to whom, and on what occasion.

expressionKind.description: An everyday phrase or greeting, an idiom whose meaning its words do not give, or a proverb or saying.

source.description: Where the contributor learned the expression. The speaker is named only when the contributor supplied a name.

contributor.description: Public attribution only — never contact details.
